resource: PoPS (Polygenic Priority Score) v0.2 code + published full feature matrix

features.url_source: README.md of FinucaneLab/pops @ 76eb86c ('To download the full set of feature files used to generate the results in the manuscript')
features.access: public Dropbox shared link, no account/sign-in/terms
features.licence_note: No separate licence file accompanies the feature matrix; the code repository is GPL-3.0. Features are derived from public datasets (GTEx, mouse/human single-cell atlases, pathways, PPI) per Weeks et al. 2023 Nat Genet 55:1267. Used for research only; not redistributed.

paper: Weeks EM et al. Leveraging polygenic enrichments of gene features to predict genes underlying complex traits and diseases. Nat Genet 2023;55:1267-1276 (medRxiv 2020.09.08.20190561)

features_munged.check: all 508 features of PoPS' bundled example matrix identical (max |d| 1.4e-14)

environments.hi-pops: python 3.9, numpy 1.21.6, pandas 1.3.5, scipy 1.7.3, scikit-learn 0.24.2, OpenBLAS 0.3.25 (chr1-5)
environments.hi-pops-accel: same package versions, Apple Accelerate BLAS/LAPACK (chr6-22 and chr11 rerun); PoPS example reproduced to 4.1e-15
